<a id="cold_start"></a>
### [`cold_start`](../../../../src/init/cold_start.asm#L9) `$8E6A`

*routine*

Entry. Sets the stack, CIAs, NMI vector and $01, resets the variables, copies the screen drawer to $9e00, then runs title and game.
